title: Ancient Spartan doctor's treatise describing PTSD
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Ancient Spartan doctor's treatise describing PTSD, about Ancient Greece at Sparta, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but we have archaeological evidence that goes all the way back to the Spartans. >> And there was a doctor that had written a treatise back then.

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, speaking on a podcast, says the lasting mental scars of combat, known today as PTSD (post-traumatic stress disorder), are nothing new. He says there is archaeological evidence going back to the Spartans, the warrior people of ancient Greece, and that a Spartan doctor of that time wrote a treatise describing it. If so, people were naming combat trauma thousands of years ago.
